metadata.title: 80s New Wave Portrait with Geometric Accents

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 80s portrait featuring a central subject in denim, framed by thin geometric lines and tall, condensed pastel typography.
triggerTerms: spiky hair portrait with geometric lines

recipe.visualDefinition: A grainy, high-contrast portrait of a woman with voluminous spiky hair wearing a denim jacket, set against a neutral grey background punctuated by thin, vibrant geometric lines and tall, peach-toned condensed lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with hair breaking the top third
Thin diagonal and vertical lines cutting through negative space
Typography anchored to the top left corner
High contrast between dark denim and bright facial highlights
coreInvariants: Grainy film texture across the entire composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered horizontally, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the spiky texture of the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large display text at the top, down the vertical red line, to the subject's face, and finally to the small subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left and right of the head, filled with a soft grey gradient and grain.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool grey and muted blue denim tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: High-key white highlights on the face.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Peach-pink typography and a single vibrant red vertical line.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the portrait lighting.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
Tight letter spacing for the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a dense, modern condensed sans-serif with a widely-spaced, traditional lowercase serif.
graphicDevices: Thin vertical red line on the left
Thin diagonal blue line at the top right
Thin horizontal green/white line at the bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, narrow display proportions.
Matches the high-contrast serif subtitle style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, high-contrast portrait of a person with 80s spiky hair wearing a denim jacket against a grey background. Include a thin vertical red line on the left and a thin diagonal blue line in the top right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in an ultra-condensed peach-pink sans-serif at the top left. Below it, add a subtitle in a widely-spaced, lowercase peach-pink serif.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible across the image?
Is the display text ultra-condensed and peach-colored?
Are the thin geometric lines present and sharp?
Is the denim jacket texture clearly defined?

adjustableVariables: Color of the geometric accent lines

mustAchieve: Balanced use of peach and grey

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red line is perfectly vertical.
Ensure the peach text has a subtle dark outline for legibility.
Verify the hair texture is sharp despite the grain.
Confirm the subtitle tracking is significantly wider than the title.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Portrait + Grainy Grey Background + Ultra-Condensed Peach Type + Thin Geometric Accents
